title: Choose the visual world for The Disappearing Draft
question: The roll assigned The Countdown Room. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Countdown Room
options.lineage: mission-control countdown boards, range safety, split-flap departure boards
options.thesis: The session is a launch under range safety: a huge flip-digit countdown presides, and stillness is a hold that becomes a destruct order.
options.viewport: A console: giant flip-digit T–10:00, three placard switches (GENTLE / STANDARD / BRUTAL with their FADE/LOSS limits printed), one guarded ARM control.
options.risk: Slides toward glassy neon dashboard if the flap-and-placard physics lose their analog damping.

raised.raise: Amber caution lamp at fade-start, red only at destruction — and all motion is damped and mechanical, never a digital snap.
Running time right-aligned hard against the margin; the session and its wind-down are two hard sides of one board, flipped like a tape.
Warning color confined to a hairline band at the text column's edge while the field itself stays achromatic.
Arming the session is one deliberate guarded gesture — a switch you flip or a pin you pull — never a click.
Glow and flap motion are capability layers, off under reduced-motion; amber and red are reserved absolutely, everything else is luminance.
The console's ground system never repaints; threat state rides above it as one overlay color.

options.label: Dry Ribbon
options.thesis: The draft is typed on a ribbon running dry: neglect it and the ink pales; wait too long and the page is pulled from the platen for good.
options.viewport: A page locked in the platen, spool visible at the top edge; duration as margin stops, difficulty as ribbon settings, RETURN to arm.
options.risk: The writer's totem most runs in this category reach for; its distinction rides entirely on executing the ribbon-fade literally.

options.label: Instrument Night
options.thesis: Write on instruments alone through cloud: the page outside the glass is ink, and only your needles and lamps keep the draft flying.
options.viewport: One central inactivity gauge beside a clock dial, prose streaming beneath as the chart; needles sag before alarms sound.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: amber-before-red lamp hierarchy maps exactly onto fade→delete, and desk-scale night intimacy matches the writer's scene; loses narrowly because its six-gauge constellation is structurally blocked by the time-only HUD.
options.risk: A clock-as-dial reads less authoritative than a flap countdown for duration; the green needle adds a third signal color to learn.

options.label: Side A
options.thesis: The session is a cassette recording: the tape runs while you press on, and when you stop, the erase head crosses the tape from the top, wiping as it goes.
options.viewport: The folded inlay card: SIDE A ruled lines with running times right-aligned, duration as tape length (C-45/C-60), difficulty as the brand stripe, REC ● to arm.
options.case: Fuses strongly: record-over-erase is native permanence, running times are native countdowns, and the writer's vernacular resonance is the highest on the table; loses on clarity because the gradual erase-sweep is invented physics and the handwritten world mismatches a keyboard product.
options.risk: Ballpoint-on-white reads stationery-gentle when the product needs lethal; light-mode softness under a night-desk scene.

options.label: Spectral Fringe
options.case: Fuses poorly: dissolving vapor is gentle where the product is lethal, and the weather-observer world is not the writers'.
options.kept: The hairline edge-band cue: warning color at the boundary, never flooding the field.

options.label: Drawcord Session
options.case: Fuses poorly: drape and silhouette carry no native clock and no deletion threat.
options.kept: The one-gesture arm ritual: a session begun by a single deliberate pull, not a click.

options.label: Phosphor Grid
options.case: Fuses poorly: a 240-line pixel grid fights paragraph legibility, and the gamer's world is not the writer's.
options.kept: Capability-layer motion with an absolute two-color caution law: effects toggle off cleanly, warning colors are never spent twice.

options.label: Course Overlay
options.case: Fuses poorly: the world has no native inactivity threat, and its dense color language fights the minimal HUD.
options.kept: Fixed ground, one reserved overlay: session state rides above the terrain and never repaints it.

canonCard.label: Quiet Room
canonCard.thesis: The calm focus-writing canvas this category ships, played impeccably straight.
canonCard.viewport: A centered text column, a small timer above it, a gentle Begin.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every writing app by design; the deletion threat reads as a suggestion.
